description: Every hazard the collection constructors have is about the iterable, and ECMA-262 returns before all of it when the argument is absent. The entry states that as a condition on passing nothing rather than as a color, so the call site decides: `new Map()` is clean however the type arguments are written, and an explicit `undefined` or `null` is clean too, because the guard ECMA-262 writes is `either undefined or null` — the wider of the two absence forms, and the reason there are two. `narrowedToNothing` is why the condition is read off the syntax and never off the type: the checker narrows `held` to `undefined` there, and a closure has already written an iterable into it.
